title: Make Every Expansion Count: Learning to Search Efficiently in LLM Code Repair
abstract: arXiv:2610.15894v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) code-repair systems fix faulty programs by repeatedly generating and testing revisions. Each revision is costly, making the choice of which repair to pursue important for efficiency. Existing search policies rely on test pass rates and search statistics, ignoring the details of test failures and proposed edits. We introduce CodeTriage, a learned policy that prioritizes edits before their revised programs are generated and tested. Its 0.6B-parameter model reads the test output, failure diagnosis, and proposed edit, then predicts a distribution over the number of repair steps needed to reach a fix through that edit. These predictions prioritize all pending edits across programs before generating and testing the revised code. translated_title: 让每一次扩展都有价值：学习在LLM代码修复中高效搜索
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）代码修复系统通过反复生成并测试修订版本来修复有缺陷的程序。每次修订的成本都很高，因此选择优先 pursued 哪个修复方案对效率至关重要。现有的搜索策略依赖于测试通过率和搜索统计信息，而忽略了测试失败的细节以及所提出的编辑内容。我们提出了CodeTriage，这是一种学习型策略，能够在修改后的程序被生成和测试之前就对编辑进行优先级排序。该策略使用一个0.6B参数的模型，读取测试输出、失败诊断和所提出的编辑内容，然后预测通过该编辑达到修复所需的修复步骤数量的分布。这些预测会在生成和测试修改后的代码之前，对所有程序中待处理的编辑进行优先级排序。在留出的修复任务上，CodeTriage在各项指标上分别比最强基线少21%的程序修订次数和少12%的输出token数即可找到修复方案。无需重新训练，它即可实现……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: CodeTriage通过一个0.6B参数的学习模型，在生成和测试代码之前预测每个候选编辑达到修复所需的步数分布，从而对编辑进行智能优先级排序，比最强基线少用21%的程序修订次数和12%的输出token即可找到修复方案。
en_tdlr: CodeTriage is a learned 0.6B-parameter policy that predicts the number of repair steps needed for each candidate edit before code generation and testing, prioritizing edits intelligently to find fixes with 21% fewer program revisions and 12% fewer output tokens than the strongest baseline.
